newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT details TNT share buy.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT details TNT share buy.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV said on Wednesday it had bought a 9.9 percent holding in Australian transport and logistics group TNT in the market to support its earlier US$1.6 billion bid for the firm.
It said its KPN Australia unit had bought 9.9 percent of TNT's issued ordinary shares and 9.9 percent of its issued converting preference shares.
"As a result of these purchases, KPN (Australia) now owns 9.9 percent of the issued share capital of TNT," Dutch PTT said in a statement.
It said the 57,961,751 ordinary shares had been bought at prices up to A$2.45 per share while the 20,790,000 TNT converting preference shares had been bought at prices up to A$2.51 per share.
The preference share price reflected dividend rights for the six months to November 30, it said.
The preference dividend amounts to 6.2 Australian cents.
